what: The verifier CLI command fails on this host with ImportError (libtt_metal.so: undefined symbol MPIX_Comm_shrink) because bare python3 does not get the LD_PRELOAD=generated/mpix_shim/libmpix_shim.so shim that run_safe_pytest.sh / eval_test_runner.sh apply; the golden run succeeds and only the post-step breaks
suggest: Have eval_test_runner.sh run verify_supported itself, or document the LD_PRELOAD shim beside the CLI command

ref: verifier prompt: Grouping refinements / Anchor the first two refinements / Perf refinements (2:1 cadence)
what: The queue rules assume at least two generality refinements (target 3-5, a too-small refinement must be bundled, R1+R2 land the perf-1 contract, perf in slot 3). When TARGET-SUPPORTED is one declaration-only gap (here dtype bf8b/bf4b + one EXCLUSION, kernels already bit-exact), they conflict: nothing exists to bundle, R2 cannot be generality, and it is unclear whether the design-deferred perf regime should be bundled into R1 or filed as perf
suggest: State the single-generality-gap case explicitly: one small R1 is allowed when it empties TARGET-SUPPORTED, perf phases follow directly, and measured perf levers stay in perf refinements even when the design deferred them to that refinement
